relations.statement: The quotient map is well defined for a MubCochainObstructionContract.
Without C3 atlas coherence the contract gives no full MUB6 authority.

lemmas.statement: The obstruction-signature bound is stated only after a finite 2-truncated cochain, a quotient, and an observer gauge are declared as extra data; carrier, comparison, residual, and observer gauge are not supplied by the two marks.
The unfiled holding k_hosts_that_are_not_a_difference does not close the k-host census.

near_misses.claim: The k=3 and k=5 leftovers computed in the unfiled holding close the k-host census.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Two computed cases do not cover all k at least 3; the holding is unfiled and AuthorityEffect is None.

open_obligations: Ground carrier, comparison, residual and observer gauge generators with existing declarations; signatures of ObserverGauge and gauge_quotient items were not given.
The k_hosts_that_are_not_a_difference holding is not in SRC and cannot be cited.
triangleD0 signature, arity and carrier were not stated in SRC, so the generator is only proposed.
